fixes.description: Session store uses volatile in-memory Map; data lost on process restart
No structured JSON logger; console.log/warn/error used without consistent fields
fixes.fix: Create lib/logger.ts with fields: ts, level, requestId, participantId (hashed), operation, durationMs, status

fixes.description: No queue size limit on in-memory session store

warnings.detail: lib/experiment/session-store.ts uses a module-level Map — data lost on Next.js restart. No SQLite or file-based persistence exists. This is a P1 defect for Supabase-down scenarios.
Logs use console.warn/error but lack requestId, participantId pseudonym, operationDuration, retryCount fields. P3 — Add structured JSON logger.
HTTP 200 — server accepts non-UUID participant IDs. P3 — Consider UUID format validation
In-memory store (session-store.ts) does not survive process restart. Submission accepted in this run would be LOST if server restarts. P1 defect.
The in-memory session store has no configurable size limit. Under sustained load without Supabase, the store grows unbounded. P2 — Add configurable MAX_LOCAL_SESSIONS with LRU eviction or rejection.
